column3: śryādināthāya namo .stu tasmai yenopadiṣṭā vibhrājate pronnatarājayogam āroḍhum icchor adhirohiṇīva |
manthāno bhairavo yogī siddhir buddhaś ca kanthaḍiḥ |
allāmaḥ prabhudevaś ca ghoḍā colī ca ṭiṇṭiṇiḥ |
bhānukī nāradevaś ca khaṇḍaḥ kāpālikas tathā ||
haṭhavidyā paraṁ gopyā yoginā siddhim icchatā |
bhaved vīryavatī guptā nirvīryā tu prakāśitā ||
alpadvāram arandhragartavivaraṁ nātyuccanīcāyataṁ bāhye maṇḍapavedikūparuciraṁ prākārasaṁveṣṭitaṁ |
janasaṅgaś ca laulyaṁ ca ṣaḍbhir yogo vinaśyati ||
utsāhāt sāhasād dhairyāt tattvajñānāc ca niścayāt |
ahiṁsā satyam asteyaṁ brahmacaryaṁ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ |
dayārjavaṁ mitāhāraḥ śaucaṁ caiva yamā daśa ||
kuryāt tad āsanaṁ sthairyam ārogyaṁ cāṅgalāghavam |
vasiṣṭhādyaiś ca munibhir matsyendrādyaiś ca yogibhiḥ ||
jānūrvor antare samyak kṛtvā pādatale ubhe ||
ekaṁ pādaṁ tathaikasmin vinyased uruṇi sthiram ||
kūrmāsanaṁ bhaved etad iti yogavido viduḥ |
padmāsanaṁ tu saṁsthāpya jānūrvor antare karau ||
pragṛhya tiṣṭhet parivartitāṅgaḥ śrīmatsyanāthoditam matsyendrapīṭhaṁ jaṭharapradīptiṁ |
abhyāsataḥ kuṇḍalinīprabodhaṁ candrasthiratvaṁ ca prasārya pādau bhuvi daṇḍarūpau dorbhyāṁ |
udayaṁ jaṭharānalasya kuryād udare kārśyam arogatāṁ ca dharām avaṣṭabhya karadvayena |
uccāsano daṇḍavad utthitaḥ khe māyūram etat pravadanti harati sakalarogān āśu gulmodarādīn abhibhavati ca doṣān |
bahu kadaśanabhuktaṁ bhasma kuryād aśeṣaṁ janayati uttānaṁ śavavad bhūmau śayanaṁ tac chavāsanam ||
tebhyaś catuṣkam ādāya sārabhūtaṁ bravīmy aham |
siddhaṁ padmaṁ tathā siṁhaṁ bhadraṁ veti catuṣṭayam |
śreṣṭhaṁ tatrāpi ca sukhe tiṣṭhet siddhāsane sadā ||
yonisthānakam aṅghrimūlaghaṭitaṁ kṛtvā dṛḍhaṁ vinyaset sthāṇuḥ saṁyamitendriyo .caladṛśā paśyed bhruvor |
meṇḍhrād upari vinyasya savyaṁ gulphaṁ tathopari |
gulphāntaraṁ ca nikṣipya siddhāsanam idaṁ bhavet ||
etat siddhāsanaṁ prāhur anye vajrāsanaṁ viduḥ |
muktāsanaṁ vadanty eke prāhur guptāsanaṁ pare ||
kim anyair bahubhiḥ pīṭhaiḥ siddhe siddhāsane sati |
tathaikasminn eva dṛḍhe siddhe siddhāsane sati ||
dakṣorūpari paścimena vidhinā dhṛtvā karābhyāṁ dṛḍham aṅguṣṭhau hṛdaye nidhāya cibukaṁ nāsāgram ālokayet ||
ūrumadhye tathottānau pāṇī kṛtvā tato dṛśau |
uttambhya cibukaṁ vakṣasy utthāpya pavanaṁ śanaiḥ |
vāraṁ vāram apānam ūrdhvam anilaṁ protsārayan padmāsane sthito yogī nāḍīdvāreṇa pūritam ||
mārutaṁ dhārayed yas tu sa mukto nātra saṁśayaḥ |
gulphau ca vṛṣaṇasyādhaḥ sīvanyāḥ pārśvayoḥ kṣipet ||
dakṣiṇe savyagulphaṁ tu dakṣagulphaṁ tu savyake |
hastau tu jānvoḥ saṁsthāpya svāṅgulīḥ samprasārya ca ||
gulphau ca vṛṣaṇasyādhaḥ sīvanyāḥ pārśvayoḥ kṣipte ||
savyagulphaṁ tathā savye dakṣagulphaṁ tu dakṣiṇe |
pārśvapādau ca pāṇibhyāṁ dṛḍhaṁ baddhvā suniścalam ||
gorakṣāsanam ity āhur idaṁ vai siddhayoginaḥ ||
āsanaṁ kumbhakaṁ citraṁ mudrākhyaṁ karaṇaṁ tathā |
abdād ūrdhvaṁ bhavet siddho nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
column5: brahmacārī mitāhārī tyāgī yogaparāyaṇaḥ |abdād ūrdhvaṁ bhavet siddho nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
susnigdhaṁ madhurāhāraṁ caturthāṁśavivarjitam |bhujyate surasamprītyai mitāhāraḥ sa ucyate ||

column3: bhojanam ahitaṁ vidyāt punar asyoṣṇīkṛtaṁ rūkṣam |
puṣṭaṁ sumadhuraṁ snigdhaṁ gavyaṁ dhātuprapoṣaṇam mano.bhilaṣitaṁ yogyaṁ yogī bhojanam ācaret ||
yuvo vṛddho .tivṛddho vā vyādhito durbalo.pi vā |
kriyāyuktasya siddhiḥ syād akriyasya kathaṁ bhavet |
na veṣadhāraṇaṁ siddheḥ kāraṇaṁ na ca tatkathā |
kriyaiva kāraṇaṁ siddheḥ satyam etan na saṁśayaḥ ||
pīṭhāni kumbhakāś citrā divyāni karaṇāni ca |
cale vāte calaṁ cittaṁ niścale niścalaṁ bhavet |
yogī sthāṇutvam āpnoti tato vāyuṁ nirodhayet ||
column5: cale vāte calo bindur niścale niścalo bhavet |yogī sthāṇutvam āpnoti tato vāyuṁ nirodhayet ||

column3: yāvad vāyuḥ sthito dehe tāvaj jīvanam ucyate |
maraṇaṁ tasya niṣkrāntis tato vāyuṁ nirodhayet ||
column5: yāvad vāyuḥ sthito dehe tāvaj jīvanam ucyate |maraṇaṁ tasya niṣkrāntis tato vāyuṁ nirodhayet ||

column3: kathaṁ syād unmanībhāvaḥ kāryasiddhiḥ kathaṁ bhavet ||
śuddhim eti yadā sarvaṁ nāḍīcakraṁ malākulam |

column5: śuddhim eti yadā sarvaṁ nāḍīcakraṁ malākulam |tadaiva jāyate yogī prāṇasaṁgrahaṇe kṣamaḥ ||

column3: prāṇāyāmaṁ tataḥ kuryān nityaṁ sāttvikayā dhiyā |
yathā suṣumṇānāḍīsthā malāḥ śuddhiṁ prayānti ca ||

column5: baddhapadmāsano yogī prāṇaṁ candreṇa pūrayet |dhārayitvā yathāśakti bhūyaḥ sūryeṇa recayet ||

column3: prāṇaṁ sūryeṇa cākṛṣya pūrayed udaraṁ śanaiḥ |
vidhivat kumbhakaṁ kṛtvā punaś candreṇa recayet ||
yena tyajet tena pītvā dhārayed anirodhataḥ |
recayec ca tato.nyena śanair eva na vegataḥ ||
prāṇaṁ ced iḍayā piben niyamitaṁ bhūyo .nyayā recayet sūryacandramasor anena vidhinābhyāsaṁ sadā tanvatāṁ |
prātar madhyaṁdine sāyam ardharātre ca kumbhakān |
kanīyasi bhavet svedaḥ kampo bhavati madhyame |
uttame sthānam āpnoti tato vāyuṁ nibandhayet ||
dṛḍhatā laghutā caiva tena gātrasya jāyate ||
yathā siṁho gajo vyāghro bhaved vaśyaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
tathaiva sevito vāyur anyathā hanti sādhakam ||
hikkā śvāsaś ca kāsaś ca śiraḥkarṇākṣivedanāḥ |
yuktaṁ yuktaṁ tyajed vāyuṁ yuktaṁ yuktaṁ ca pūrayet |
yuktaṁ yuktaṁ ca badhnīyād evaṁ siddhim avāpnuyāt ||
yadā tu nāḍīśuddhiḥ syāt tathā cihnāni bāhyataḥ |
kāyasya kṛśatā kāntis tadā jāyate niścitam ||

column5: yatheṣṭaṁ dhāraṇaṁ vāyor analasya pradīpanam |nādābhivyaktir ārogyaṁ jāyate nāḍiśodhanāt ||

column3: anyas tu nācaret tāni doṣāṇāṁ samabhāvataḥ ||
dhautir vastis tathā netis trāṭakaṁ naulikaṁ tathā |
punaḥ pratyāharec caitad uditaṁ dhautikarma tat |
aśeṣadoṣopacayaṁ nihanyād abhyasyamānaṁ sūtraṁ vitastisusnigdhaṁ nāsānāle praveśayet ||
mukhān nirgamayec caiṣā netiḥ siddhair nigadyate |
aśeṣadoṣāmayaśoṣaṇī ca haṭhakriyā maulir iyaṁ ca nauliḥ |
prāṇāyāmair eva sarve praśuṣyanti malā iti ||
kramaparicayavaśyanāḍicakrā gajakaraṇīti nigadyate brahmādayo .pi tridaśāḥ pavanābhyāsatatparāḥ ||
yāvad baddho marud dehe yāvac cittaṁ nirākulam ||
yāvad dṛṣṭir bhruvor madhye tāvat kālabhayaṁ kutaḥ |
āpānam ūrdhvam utthāpya prāṇaṁ kaṇṭhād adho nayet ||
āsane sukhade yogī baddhvā caivāsanaṁ tataḥ ||
ā keśād ā nakhāgrāc ca nirodhāvadhi kumbhayet ||
tataḥ śanaiḥ savyanāḍyā recayet pavanaṁ śanaiḥ |
punaḥ punar idaṁ kāryaṁ sūryabhedanam uttamam |
mukhaṁ saṁyamya nāḍībhyām ākṛṣya pavanaṁ śanaiḥ |
yathā lagati kaṇṭhāt tu hṛdayāvadhi sasvanam ||
pūrvavat kumbhayet prāṇaṁ recayed iḍayā tathā |
gacchatā tiṣṭhatā kāryam ujjāyyākhyaṁ tu kumbhakam ||
śītkārīṁ kuryāt tathā vaktre ghrāṇenaiva vijṛmbhikām |
na kṣudhā na tṛṣā nidrā naivālasyaṁ prajāyate ||
gulmaplīhādikān rogān jvaraṁ pittaṁ kṣudhāṁ tṛṣām |
viṣāṇi śītalī nāma kumbhikeyaṁ nihanti hi ||
ūrvor upari saṁsthāpya śubhe pādatale ubhe |
mukhaṁ saṁyamya yatnena prāṇaṁ ghrāṇena recayet ||
punar virecayet tadvat pūrayec ca punaḥ punaḥ |
yadā śramo bhaved dehe tadā sūryeṇa pūrayet ||
yathodaraṁ bhavet pūrṇam anilena tathā laghu |
vegād ghoṣaṁ pūrakaṁ bhṛṅganādaṁ bhṛṅgīnādaṁ yogīndrāṁśam evam abhyāsayogāc citte jātā kācid |
sahitaḥ kevalaś ceti kumbhako dvividho mataḥ ||
yāvat kevalasiddhiḥ syāt sahitaṁ tāvad abhyaset |
recakaṁ pūrakaṁ muktvā sukhaṁ yad vāyudhāraṇam ||
prāṇāyāmo.yam ity uktaḥ sa vai kevalakumbhakaḥ |
na tasya durlabhaṁ kiṁcit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate |
anargalā suṣumṇā ca haṭhasiddhiś ca jāyate ||
haṭhaṁ vinā rājayogo rājayogaṁ vinā haṭhaḥ |
na sidhyati tato yugmam ā niṣpatteḥ samabhyaset ||
vapuḥkṛśatvaṁ vadane prasannatā nādasphuṭatvaṁ arogatā bindujayo.gnidīpanaṁ nāḍīviśuddhir |
tadā sarvāṇi padmāni bhidyante granthayo.pi ca ||
tadā cittaṁ nirālambaṁ tadā kālasya vañcanam ||
prasāritaṁ padaṁ kṛtvā karābhyāṁ dhārayed dṛḍham ||
kaṇṭhe bandhaṁ samāropya dhārayed vāyum ūrdhvataḥ |
ṛjvī bhūtā tathā śaktiḥ kuṇḍalī sahasā bhavet |
tataḥ śanaiḥ śanair eva recayen naiva vegataḥ |
candrāṅge tu samabhyasya sūryāṅge punar abhyaset |
yāvattulyā bhavet saṁkhyā tato mudrāṁ visarjayet ||
column5: candrāṅgena samabhyasya sūryāṅgenābhyaset punaḥ |yāvat tulyā bhavet saṁkhyā tato mudrāṁ visarjayet ||

column3: na hi pathyam apathyaṁ vā rasāḥ sarve.pi nīrasāḥ |
api bhuktaṁ viṣaṁ ghoraṁ pīyūṣam api jīryati ||
column5: na hi pathyam apathyaṁ vā rasāḥ sarve .pi nīrasāḥ |api muktaṁ viṣaṁ ghoraṁ pīyūṣam api jīryate ||

column3: tasya doṣāḥ kṣayaṁ yānti mahāmudrāṁ tu yo .bhyaset ||
column5: kṣayakuṣṭhagudāvartagulmājīrṇapurogamāḥ |tasya doṣāḥ kṣayaṁ yānti mahāmudrāṁ tu yo .bhyaset ||

column3: gopanīyā prayatnena na deyā yasya kasyacit ||
column5: kathiteyaṁ mahāmudrā mahāsiddhikarā nṝṇām |gopanīyā prayatnena na deyā yasya kasyacit ||

column3: pūrayitvā tato vāyuṁ hṛdaye cubukaṁ dṛḍham |
savyāṅge tu samabhyasya dakṣāṅge punar abhyaset ||
matam atra tu keṣāṁcit kaṇṭhabandhaṁ vivarjayet |
aṣṭadhā kriyate caiva yāme yāme dine dine |
bhruvor antargatā dṛṣṭir mudrā bhavati khecarī ||
column5: kapālakuhare jihvā praviṣṭā viparītagā |bhruvor antargatā dṛṣṭir mudrā bhavati khecarī ||

column3: sā yāvad bhrūmadhyaṁ spṛśati tadā khecarīsiddhiḥ ||
evaṁ krameṇa ṣaṇmāsaṁ nityaṁ yuktaḥ samācaret |
sā bhavet khecarī mudrā vyomacakraṁ tad ucyate ||
rasanām ūrdhvagāṁ kṛtvā kṣaṇārdham api tiṣṭhati |
na rogo maraṇaṁ tandrā na nidrā na kṣudhā tṛṣā |
na ca mūrchā bhavet tasya yo mudrāṁ vetti khecarīm ||
column5: na rogo maraṇaṁ tandrā na nidrā na kṣudhā tṛṣā |na ca mūrchā bhavet tasya yo mudrāṁ vetti khecarīm ||

column3: pīḍyate na sa rogeṇa lipyate na ca karmaṇā |
bādhyate na sa kālena yo mudrāṁ vetti khecarīm ||
column5: pīḍyate na sa rogeṇa lipyate na ca karmaṇā |bādhyate na sa kālena yo mudrāṁ vetti khecarīm ||

column3: cittaṁ carati khe yasmāj jihvā carati khe gatā |
tenaiṣā khecarī nāma mudrā siddhair nirūpitā ||
na tasya kṣarate binduḥ kāminyāḥ śleṣitasya ca ||
column5: khecaryā mudritaṁ yena vivaraṁ lambikordhvataḥ |na tasya kṣarate binduḥ kāminyāliṅgitasya ca ||

column3: vrajaty ūrdhvaṁ hṛtaḥ śaktyā nibaddho yonimudrayā ||
ūrdhvajihvaḥ sthiro bhūtvā somapānaṁ karoti yaḥ |
māsārdhena na saṁdeho mṛtyuṁ jayati yogavit ||
takṣakeṇāpi daṣṭasya viṣaṁ tasya na sarpati ||
indhanāni yathā vahnis tailavartiṁ ca dīpakaḥ |
tathā somakalāpūrṇaṁ dehī dehaṁ na muñcati ||
kulīnaṁ tam ahaṁ manye cetare kulaghātakāḥ ||
gośabdenoditā jihvā tat praveśo hi tāluni |
candrāt sravati yaḥ sāraḥ sā syād amaravāruṇī ||
cumbantī yadi lambikāgram aniśaṁ jihvārasasyandinī vyādhīnāṁ haraṇaṁ jarāntakaraṇaṁ śastrāgamodīraṇaṁ |
mūrdhnaḥ ṣoḍaśapattrapadmagalitaṁ prāṇād avāptaṁ utkallolakalājalaṁ ca vimalaṁ dhārāmayaṁ yaḥ piben |
yat prāleyaṁ prahitasuṣiraṁ merumūrdhāntarasthaṁ candrāt sāraḥ sravati vapuṣas tena mṛtyur narāṇāṁ tad |
tiṣṭhate khecarī mudrā tasmin śūnye nirañjane ||
ekaṁ sṛṣṭimayaṁ bījam ekā mudrā ca khecarī |
baddho yena suṣumṇāyāṁ prāṇas tūḍḍīyate yataḥ |
uḍḍīyānaṁ tad eva syāt tatra bandho.bhidhīyate ||
udare paścimaṁ tānaṁ nābher ūrdhvaṁ ca kārayet |
uḍḍīyānaṁ tu sahajaṁ guruṇā kathitaṁ sadā |
abhyaset satataṁ yas tu vṛddho.pi taruṇāyate ||
nābher ūrdhvam adhaś cāpi tānaṁ kuryāt prayatnataḥ |
ṣaṇmāsam abhyasen mṛtyuṁ jayaty eva na saṁśayaḥ ||
sarveṣām eva bandhānām uttamo hy uḍḍīyānakaḥ |
uḍḍiyāne dṛḍhe bandhe muktiḥ svābhāvikī bhavet ||

column5: pārṣṇibhāgena saṁpīḍya yonim ākuñcayed gudam |apānam ūrdhvam ākṛṣya mūlabandho .bhidhīyate ||

column3: adhogatim apānaṁ vā ūrdhvagaṁ kurute balāt |
ākuñcanena taṁ prāhur mūlabandhaṁ hi yoginaḥ ||
gudaṁ pārṣṇyā tu saṁpīḍya vāyum ākuñcayed balāt |
vāraṁ vāraṁ yathā cordhvaṁ samāyāti samīraṇaḥ ||
gatvā yogasya saṁsiddhiṁ yacchato nātra saṁśayaḥ ||

column5: apānaprāṇayor aikyāt kṣayān mūtrapurīṣayoḥ |yuvā bhavati vṛddho .pi satataṁ mūlabandhanāt ||

column3: tasmān nityaṁ mūlabandhaḥ kartavyo yogibhiḥ sadā ||
kaṇṭham ākuñcya hṛdaye sthāpayec cibukaṁ dṛḍham |
na pīyūṣaṁ pataty agnau na ca vāyuḥ prakupyati ||
column5: jālaṁdhare kṛte bandhe kaṇṭhasaṁkocalakṣaṇe |pīyūṣaṁ na pataty agnau na ca vāyuḥ prakupyati ||

column3: iḍāṁ ca piṅgalāṁ baddhvā vāhayet paścime pathi ||
tato na jāyate mṛtyur jarārogādikaṁ tathā ||
bandhatrayam idaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ mahāsiddhaiś ca sevitam |
yat kiṁcit sravate candrād amṛtaṁ divyarūpiṇaḥ |
tat sarvaṁ grasate sūryas tena piṇḍo jarāyutaḥ ||
ūrdhvanābher adhas tālor ūrdhvaṁ bhānur adhaḥ śaśī |
āhāro bahulas tasya saṁpādyaḥ sādhakasya ca ||
alpāhāro yadi bhaved agnir dahati tatkṣaṇāt |
adhaḥśirāś cordhvapādaḥ kṣaṇaṁ syāt prathame dine ||
kṣaṇāc ca kiṁcid adhikam abhyasec ca dine dine |
valitaṁ palitaṁ caiva ṣaṇmāsordhvaṁ na dṛśyate |
yāmamātraṁ tu yo nityam abhyaset sa tu kālajit ||
vajrolīṁ yo vijānāti sa yogī siddhibhājanam ||
tatra vastudvayaṁ vakṣye durlabhaṁ yasya kasyacit |
kṣīraṁ caikaṁ dvitīyaṁ tu nārī ca vaśavartinī ||
calitaṁ ca nijaṁ bindum ūrdhvam ākṛṣya rakṣayet ||
yāvad binduḥ sthiro dehe tāvat kālabhayaṁ kutaḥ ||
cittāyattaṁ nṝṇāṁ śukraṁ śukrāyattaṁ ca jīvitam |
tasmāc chukraṁ manaś caiva rakṣaṇīyaṁ prayatnataḥ ||
ṛtumatyā rajo.py evaṁ nijaṁ binduṁ ca rakṣayet |
sahajolir iyaṁ proktā śraddheyā yogibhiḥ sadā |
nirmatsarāṇāṁ vai sidhyen na tu matsaraśālinām ||
pittolbaṇatvāt prathamāmbudhārāṁ vihāya niḥsāratayānty niṣevyate śītalamadhyadhārā kāpālike khaṇḍamate .marolī |
amarīṁ yaḥ piben nityaṁ nasyaṁ kurvan dine dine |
abhyāsān niḥsṛtāṁ cāndrīṁ vibhūtyā saha miśrayet |
yadi nārī rajo rakṣed vajrolyā sāpi yoginī ||
tasyāḥ kiṁcid rajo nāśaṁ na gacchati na saṁśayaḥ |
tasyāḥ śarīre nādaś ca bindutām eva gacchati ||
sa bindus tad rajaś caiva ekībhūya svadehagau |
rakṣed ākuñcanād ūrdhvaṁ yā rajaḥ sā hi yoginī |
atītānāgataṁ vetti khecarī ca bhaved dhruvam ||
ayaṁ puṇyakaro yogo bhoge bhukte.pi muktidaḥ ||
udghāṭayet kapāṭaṁ tu yathā kuñcikayā haṭhāt |
kandordhve kuṇḍalī śaktiḥ suptā mokṣāya yoginām |
bandhanāya ca mūḍhānāṁ yas tāṁ vetti sa yogavit ||
sā śaktiś cālitā yena sa mukto nātra saṁśayaḥ ||
balātkāreṇa gṛhṇīyāt tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṁ padam ||
iḍā bhagavatī gaṅgā piṅgalā yamunā nadī |
